name: Shri Keshav Cements And Infra Ltd

facts.business: Shri Keshav Cements and Infra Limited manufactures cement and generates renewable solar power.

auditor.name: Singhi & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Advance payment of GST amounting to Rs. 641.52 Lakhs plus interest and penalties of Rs. 218.11 Lakhs made in FY 2020-21 & 2021-22 based on GST Intelligence search; investigation by DGGI not complete and no order passed till March 31, 2026, amounts included in other current assets, impact on financial statements cannot be commented upon.

key_risks: GST investigation by DGGI not complete, advance payments of Rs. 641.52 Lakhs plus interest and penalties of Rs. 218.11 Lakhs may have uncertain impact on financial statements
facts.related_party_note: The Company has entered into transactions with related parties in compliance with the provisions of Sections 177 and 188 of the Companies Act, 2013. The details of related party transactions have been disclosed in the financial statements as required under Indian Accounting Standard 24.
